prompts.unit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: production Unity uGUI card-shell PNG, blank background layer only.
Input 1 is the EXISTING CardShell_Unit sprite to edit. Input 2 is the user's desired assembled unit-card layout reference (extract layout/style only). Input 3 is the exact bottom corner ornament the user specifically wants preserved.
Create ONE standalone edited UNIT CARD SHELL, tall portrait 3:5 canvas, ideally 960x1600. Match the polished warm gold, black/charcoal subtle gradient interiors, burgundy cloth, smooth illustrated demon-fantasy style of input 1 and the more readable layout of input 2. Keep the entire card silhouette fully inside the image with a narrow transparent margin. Real alpha transparency OUTSIDE the silhouette ONLY; every enclosed black/charcoal panel must be fully opaque.
Most important correction: at the upper left and upper right, use EXACTLY ONE red hanging swallowtail banner per side. Remove the second overlapping/offset red strip on BOTH sides. A single uninterrupted cloth silhouette per side with one V-cut end; no cloth behind it, no second lower red tail. Keep the horned gold skull crest centered at the top.
Layout based on input 2: empty header between thin gold horizontal rules; medium artwork window with clipped/chamfered gold corners (shorter vertically than original); one shallow full-width occupancy row with a blank burgundy label tab at its left; below it a substantially TALLER full-width combat-information panel with another matching blank burgundy label tab at left; roomy bottom stats area with only TWO thin vertical gold separators, no boxes around the individual stats. Preserve the small side decorations of the two label tabs as in input 2. Bottom center has the small faceted gold diamond from input 2. Preserve BOTH bottom outside CORNERS from input 1/input 3: the upturned angular gold flourish and curled tip, mirror-symmetric. Do NOT replace these two corners by simple round curls. Remove the original bottom-center hanging red banner in favor of the reference's gold center diamond.
Strictly omit ALL runtime content: no title text, no digits, no writing, no type circle badge, no star badge, no crossed swords, no stat icons, no heart/shield, no unit character, no terrain, no plus sign, no grid or occupied cells. Blank shell art only. No checkerboard pixels, no background rectangle, no glow or shadow outside the silhouette, no collage.
